subject.title: fix(hooks): bound HOOK.md reads during hook install validation

question: Should hook installation intentionally reject `HOOK.md` files over 1 MiB and symlinked or other non-regular `HOOK.md` paths?
rationale: The patch fixes the unbounded read cleanly, but its shared reader also turns an implicit filesystem behavior into a compatibility boundary that current hook documentation does not define.

options.title: Accept the bounded contract
options.body: Treat a 1 MiB regular-file `HOOK.md` as the supported install contract and merge after exact-head checks.

options.title: Preserve symlink layouts
options.body: Choose a bounded within-root follow policy if symlinked hook metadata is intended to remain supported.

options.title: Define one shared policy
options.body: Coordinate the limit and failure semantics with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101472 before landing either change.

recommendation.title: Accept the bounded contract
recommendation.body: Treat a 1 MiB regular-file `HOOK.md` as the supported install contract and merge after exact-head checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The hook-install path and much of its subsequent install and security maintenance are most strongly connected to this history.
